title: Restricted Non-Adaptive Crop-Root View Producer
purpose: Implement the smallest crop-owned read-only producer for crop_root_state_view_t on the non-adaptive root-distribution route, using an explicit current root-depth snapshot plus immutable grid/root-density parameters. Root-growth evolution and ET remain outside scope.

admitted_physics.root_depth_source: explicit current physical root depth supplied by the owning crop/root state path

input_contract.table_translation: The adapter-facing representation is structured x/y arrays rather than legacy packed RDCTB storage. Linear interpolation and end clamping must remain source-equivalent to AFGEN.

legacy_equivalence_rules: For an emerged crop with current_root_depth < 1e-14 cm, emit an emerged zero-root canonical view without requiring a root-density table.
For active roots, rooted_nodes is the first node whose bottom lies deeper than the current root depth according to the source-bound B1.10 node-boundary rule.
For non-adaptive distribution, reconstruct the normalized cumulative maximum-root-zone distribution by trapezoidal integration of RDCTB values sampled at node-bottom relative depths.
Sample that normalized cumulative distribution at each active rooted-node bottom divided by the bottom depth of rooted_nodes to reproduce cumdens_top.
Output cumulative_root_fraction has rooted_nodes+1 values, starts at exactly 0 and ends at exactly 1 after qualified canonicalization.

boundary_ambiguity_policy.reason: F-WOF16 has no lifecycle-phase input and therefore must not silently choose between the two legacy node-boundary tolerances in the only region where they can disagree.

validation: active node count and node-bottom-depth shape must be valid
positive-down node bottoms must be finite, positive and strictly increasing
maximum root depth must be finite, positive and contained by the grid
active current root depth must be finite, nonnegative and no greater than maximum root depth
RDCTB x/y arrays must be finite, same-sized, contain at least two points, start at relative depth 0, end at relative depth 1, have strictly increasing x values and nonnegative density values
the trapezoidal root-density integral must be strictly positive
qualification_tests: multi-node nonuniform RDCTB profile against independent B1.10 oracle
rooted-node mapping against independent negative-zbotcp B1.10 oracle
forbidden: legacy packed-table or file I/O inside the producer
